title: Bill status and roll-call evidence
brief: Track bill status updates and named roll-call votes. The status API is supported; the authored vote document is a PDF requiring a separate extraction connector. Preserve that unresolved need.
review_notes: Authored development contract, not independently human-reviewed. Endpoints, records, and search ordering are synthetic.

unsupported.name: Roll-call PDF
unsupported.limitation: PDF table extraction is unsupported; a bill status does not identify individual votes.

manual_checks: Review relevance and whether the source scope answers the full brief.
